verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developer.rippling.com. It contains agent-directed guidance on Bearer-token auth, API version pinning, cursor pagination and SDK version checks, and a second llms.txt exists at rippling.com. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt specifically covers the IT product surfaces (device and identity endpoints) rather than only the general platform API, and independent reports of agents using it successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.rippling.com/llms.txt # Rippling Developer Documentation
Pin a dated API version with the `Rippling-Api-Version` header (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
Run `npm view @rippling/rippling-sdk version` or check https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rippling/rippling-sdk before pinning a version.
